tools.name: list_vendors
tools.description: List ERP vendors with id, name, fact count and available topics.

tools.name: vendor_facts
tools.description: Return sourced facts for one ERP vendor (id or name; aliases: bc/business central/dynamics, sap b1/sap, sage 100/sage x3). Optional topic filter. Max 15 facts.

tools.name: einvoicing_status
tools.description: French e-invoicing (PA) status per vendor plus the national einvoicing_france block. Optional vendor filter.

tools.name: support_deadlines
tools.description: Support / maintenance end dates per ERP vendor. Optional vendor filter. Max 15 facts.

tools.name: odoo_20_changes
tools.description: Breaking and notable changes in Odoo 20. Optional area filter (requirements, security, frontend, orm, modules, api, functional, ecosystem). Max 15.

tools.name: sources_and_method
tools.description: Dataset checked_on date, certainty levels, volatility rule, GitHub repository and JAIKIN site.
